title: Hybrid End-to-End Knowledge Graph Construction and Validation: A Cross-Domain Study with LLM-as-a-Judge

contributions.purpose: 提出端到端模块化混合KG构建管线
contributions.mechanism: LLM本体归纳/评判与规则化IE、ER分离,五阶段可裁剪
contributions.evaluation: 三语料<$3、分钟级运行(FiQA约22分钟内)
contributions.source_quote: We introduce an end-to-end, modular KG pipeline that cleanly separates LLM-centric reasoning (ontology induction and judging) from deterministic extraction and resolution.

contributions.mechanism: 在FiQA/DocRED/CDR上复用规则栈仅改配置
contributions.source_quote: We demonstrate cross-domain portability on FiQA, DocRED, and CDR with sub-$3 total cost per corpus and minute-scale runtimes.

contributions.mechanism: 1-5分对分层采样的node/edge按多准则评分并给诊断
contributions.source_quote: We formalize a stratified LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation method that yields interpretable node, edge, and graph scores alongside error diagnostics.

contributions.purpose: 证明不同域压不同组件
contributions.evaluation: DocRED 98.6%实体被误标为PERSON;CDR图级质量仅2.20/5(稀疏)
contributions.source_quote: we provide empirical evidence that different domains stress different components, motivating targeted refinements such as typed NER for DocRED...

self_declared_provenance.quote: Beyond the financial domain that motivated our initial system, we evaluate the framework across three distinct corpora to assess portability and robustness: finance (FiQA), general document-level relation extraction (DocRED), and biomedicine (BioCreative V CDR).

notes: 核心负结果:DocRED 98.6%实体被规则误标为PERSON致实体质量仅2.34/5;trade-off:CDR实体质量4.03/5但图级质量仅2.20/5(稀疏13边)、FiQA 475节点仅36边。checklist AI披露:实验设计[D]、分析[D]、写作[D],均用Cursor.ai+innovai.pro;统计显著性[No]理由"all done by llm"。数字自洽(表1与正文一致);代码链接匿名化为"here"未给URL。
